basic_details.job_title: SAIL CFP Dresser Cum Compounder Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Chandrapur Ferro Alloy Plant (CFP), a unit of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL), holds a walk-in interview on 26 November 2026 at the HR- L & D hall, Chandrapur Ferro Alloy Plant, Chandrapur, Maharashtra. Document verification reporting is at 10.00 AM and the interview is at 02:30 PM. There are 3 Proficiency Trainee places for Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) in the M&HS department. The training lasts 18 months with a stipend of Rs.10000 per month plus a Knowledge Enhancement Allowance. The recruiter is a Government of India enterprise.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 30 years, valid as on the date of the walk-in interview. The minimum age of engagement as Proficiency Trainee Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) is 18 years. The upper limit is relaxed by 3 years for OBC-NCL (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates and by 5 years for SC and ST candidates.

The minimum age of engagement as Proficiency Trainee Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) is 18 years. The upper limit is relaxed by 3 years for OBC-NCL (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates and by 5 years for SC and ST candidates. | The candidate must be an Indian national with the requisite qualification from an Institute recognized by the State or Central Govt. Certificates for qualification, experience, caste/category and proof of date of birth must be valid on the date of the walk-in interview. OBC-NCL and EWS (Income & Asset) certificates should be valid for Financial Year 2025-26, that is, issued on or after 1st April, 2026. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full qualification wording before attending.

salary_details.knowledge enhancement allowance: Maximum up to Rs.7020 per month, linked to attendance
salary_details.working hours: 8 hrs shift, one day off per week
salary_details.leave: 7 days of casual leave and closed holidays (or Compensatory off) for National Holidays
salary_details.medical facility: For self at CFP Dispensary and OHS only, during the training period
salary_details.details: The allowance payable is the rate multiplied by the number of available working days in a month.

important_instructions: A candidate who cannot produce the original certificates at interview or joining will not be allowed to appear or join, and the candidature will be cancelled. Candidates with a GNM / ANM / B.Sc (Nursing) qualification who lack the Certificate of Registration at joining must deposit it within three months of admittance. The admittance stays provisional until then. A Certificate of Proficiency is issued by the CFP-OHS centre after 18 months on satisfactory performance. It is not issued for provisional engagement (where registration is not submitted) or if the full training period is not completed. The engagement is purely for Proficiency Training and gives no claim to appointment in Chandrapur Ferro Alloy Plant. Candidates attend the interview at their own cost. The number of trainees is tentative. CFP may fill fewer or none, or cancel the process, without assigning any reason. Bringing influence at any stage disqualifies the candidature. False information or impersonation can lead to rejection or termination and legal action. Trainees must follow the norms of safety, discipline, conduct and professional ethics and obey the lawful orders of the Medical Administration. The court of jurisdiction for any dispute is Chandrapur, Maharashtra.
Contact persons: Umesh M Ukey, DGM (HR), 9480828991; Shakeel Ahmed Khan, AM (HR), 7587220046.

content_sections.heading: About SAIL CFP
content_sections.text: Chandrapur Ferro Alloy Plant (CFP), Mul Road, Chandrapur, is a unit of Steel Authority of India Limited, which the notice describes as a Maharatna company. The notice invites eligible Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) candidates for Proficiency Training in the Occupational Health Centre (OHS) and CFP Dispensary and OHS under the M&HS department.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice lists these alternative qualifications for the post, all valid on the date of the walk-in interview: Intermediate (10+2) with Science from any university / institution recognized by the Central or State Govt (with working experience in any Hospital / Nursing Home / Registered Doctor); OR Diploma or Certificate Course in Dresser / Compounder from any university / institution recognized by the Central or State Govt; OR B.Sc (Nursing); OR Diploma or Certificate course in General / Auxiliary Nursing & Midwife (GNM / ANM) from a recognized Institute / College affiliated to Indian Nursing Council (INC), with Certificate of Registration. The upper age limit is 30 years, valid as on the date of the walk-in interview. The minimum age of engagement as Proficiency Trainee Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) is 18 years. The upper limit is relaxed by 3 years for OBC-NCL (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates and by 5 years for SC and ST candidates. The candidate must be an Indian national with the requisite qualification from an Institute recognized by the State or Central Govt. Certificates for qualification, experience, caste/category and proof of date of birth must be valid on the date of the walk-in interview. OBC-NCL and EWS (Income & Asset) certificates should be valid for Financial Year 2025-26, that is, issued on or after 1st April, 2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the full qualification wording before attending.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled-in and signed application in the prescribed format (Annexure-A), with a recent passport size colour photograph pasted on it Letter of undertaking (Annexure-B) on non-judicial stamp paper (Rs.10/-) Qualification documents; the application form asks for self-attested pass certificates and mark sheets for educational and professional qualification (all years / semesters) Aadhar Card and PAN Card Birth Certificate; the form names the Matriculation / Secondary / Class X pass certificate as proof of date of birth Caste Certificate (SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS candidates) Address Proof and passport size photo Experience Certificate, and Internship Certificate if applicable State Nursing Council Registration certificate, which the form lists for Trainee Nurse Originals are checked at the interview and at joining. The notice gives no postal address or email for sending applications.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at 10.00 AM for document verification; the interview is at 02:30 PM. Screened candidates, chosen on a first-cum-first-serve basis, are interviewed. If more candidates appear, the interview may continue on another day, subject to their appearance at the scheduled time. Selection for Proficiency Training is made by judging performance in the interview. In case of a tie in the final cut-off score, the candidate with the higher percentage of marks in the aggregate of the qualifying qualification is selected. Selected candidates undergo a medical check-up by SAIL-CFP Hospital / Dispensary and report for training at the plant with immediate effect. Training starts shortly after selection is completed and an Offer of Admittance as Proficiency Trainee Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) is issued.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: A candidate who cannot produce the original certificates at interview or joining will not be allowed to appear or join, and the candidature will be cancelled. Candidates with a GNM / ANM / B.Sc (Nursing) qualification who lack the Certificate of Registration at joining must deposit it within three months of admittance. The admittance stays provisional until then. A Certificate of Proficiency is issued by the CFP-OHS centre after 18 months on satisfactory performance. It is not issued for provisional engagement (where registration is not submitted) or if the full training period is not completed. The engagement is purely for Proficiency Training and gives no claim to appointment in Chandrapur Ferro Alloy Plant. Candidates attend the interview at their own cost. The number of trainees is tentative. CFP may fill fewer or none, or cancel the process, without assigning any reason. Bringing influence at any stage disqualifies the candidature. False information or impersonation can lead to rejection or termination and legal action. Trainees must follow the norms of safety, discipline, conduct and professional ethics and obey the lawful orders of the Medical Administration. The court of jurisdiction for any dispute is Chandrapur, Maharashtra. Contact persons: Umesh M Ukey, DGM (HR), 9480828991; Shakeel Ahmed Khan, AM (HR), 7587220046.

faq.question: Q1. When is the SAIL CFP walk-in interview for Dresser Cum Compounder (Male)?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026 at Chandrapur. Document verification is at 10.00 AM and the interview is at 02:30 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in venue?
faq.answer: The venue is the HR- L & D hall, Chandrapur Ferro Alloy Plant, Chandrapur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q3. How many Dresser Cum Compounder places are there?
faq.answer: There are 3 Proficiency Trainee places for Dresser Cum Compounder (Male). The notice calls this number tentative.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The qualification is any one of: Intermediate (10+2) with Science (with working experience in a Hospital / Nursing Home / Registered Doctor), a Diploma or Certificate Course in Dresser / Compounder, B.Sc (Nursing), or a GNM / ANM Diploma or Certificate course from an INC-affiliated institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years as on the date of the walk-in interview, and the minimum age is 18 years. The limit is relaxed by 3 years for OBC-NCL and 5 years for SC and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs.10000 per month plus a Knowledge Enhancement Allowance of up to Rs.7020 per month, linked to attendance. The rate is Rs.260 per working day for 20 days or more, Rs.130 for 15-19 days and Nil for fewer than 15 days.

faq.question: Q7. Are HRA or other allowances paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: The notice names only the Knowledge Enhancement Allowance in addition to the Rs.10000 stipend. It also offers shared accommodation subject to availability and medical facility at CFP Dispensary and OHS during training.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the signed Annexure-A application and the Annexure-B undertaking on Rs.10 non-judicial stamp paper. Also bring qualification documents, Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Birth Certificate, Caste Certificate, Address Proof, a passport size photo and an Experience Certificate.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by performance in the interview. If scores tie at the final cut-off, the candidate with the higher aggregate percentage in the qualifying qualification is selected.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is an 18-month Proficiency Training, and the notice says it gives no claim to appointment in Chandrapur Ferro Alloy Plant. A Certificate of Proficiency is issued on satisfactory completion.
